name: David A. Varderpool
fact: The 1994 Talisman prints a Sigma Nu sophomore from Danville called Dave Vanderpool at p. 70, and Vanderpool, Dave, 70 is the only entry of anything like that surname in the index of either digitised volume. Varderpool is not a surname; Vanderpool is, and r for n is the commonest scanning slip there is. This is very probably the same man, but one letter is not a proof, so no portrait has been filed. His cell is the fourth of the third row on p. 70, counting the fifteen names down the left column five to a row, and it is staged unfiled as _unmatched-1994-95-dave-vanderpool.jpg.
